subject: EdgeScale co-funded pilot request — voucher routing and terms
messages:
From: Sandeep Kumar <sandeep.kumar@edgescale.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Cc: partners@edgescale.com
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Co-funding request for EdgeScale x Redwood pilot (marketplace listing)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the time last week. EdgeScale is preparing a small pilot with one of our retail customers to validate latency improvements and cost savings on recommendation workloads. We want to list the integration in CloudBazaar and run a 60-day trial for the customer, and we're hoping Redwood can provide co-funded promotional credits to accelerate adoption.

High-level ask:
- $30,000 in Redwood credits (co-funded with EdgeScale; EdgeScale covers 50%)
- 60-day trial extension on standard trial TTL for the customer
- One marketplace voucher code to be issued that maps to the pilot account

Pilot goals and acceptance criteria:
- Peak throughput 300 qps for inferencing small models
- Latency p95 under 120ms
- Usage metrics, a short joint case study if goals met

I've attached a short SOW and expected usage CSV. Can you advise the right way to route this internally for promo approval and voucher issuance? If there's a promo form or legal playbook we need to hit, please point me there.

Appreciate it — Sandeep

--
Sandeep Kumar
Head of Partnerships, EdgeScale Solutions
partners@edgescale.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: EdgeScale_SOW-draft.pdf (PDF, 48KB); usage-forecast-spreadsheet.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: jordan.blake@redwood.ai
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Co-funding request for EdgeScale x Redwood pilot (marketplace listing)

Ben, Marissa — forwarding EdgeScale's ask. Short version: they want a co-funded voucher (EdgeScale pays half) and a 60-day trial window for a retail pilot. Attached SOW and usage forecast.

Questions for internal routing:
- What max promo credit do we typically approve for partner-sourced marketplace pilots of this size?
- Any constraints on issuing a single voucher that maps to their market place listing?
- Legal/finance steps: do we need a formal co-funding agreement or is the marketplace voucher/partner MSA sufficient?

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben — can you confirm suggested credit amount and approval path (finance code, approval matrix)?
2) Marissa — if we approve, can you help draft the marketplace voucher wording and confirm any guardrails we should enforce (SLA, usage caps, telemetry requirements)?

I'll loop in marketplace-team if we get a green light.

Thanks,
Jordan
--
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Exec — Strategic Partners
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0133

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: jordan.blake@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: finance-approvals@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 14:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Co-funding request for EdgeScale x Redwood pilot (marketplace listing)

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed the SOW and usage estimates. From a commercial perspective here's what I'd recommend:

- Approve up to $25,000 Redwood credit for this pilot (EdgeScale covers the other 50% per their note), with a 60-day validity tied to the pilot account.
- Require a usage cap guardrail of 40k tokens/day to prevent runaway spend in the first two weeks; we'll lift after we see expected consumption.
- Issue a single voucher tied to the CloudBazaar listing (marketplace-team will attach it to the listing metadata).

Internal steps:
1) Complete the partner promo approval form (attached).
2) Once form is signed by Sales Manager, route to Finance for cost center allocation (code: PRM-PROMO-9741).
3) Marketplace team to create voucher and provide issuance link.

I'm attaching the internal promo approval template and a suggested promo terms doc. Legal has OK'd this template in the past — if SOW has any additional commercial clauses we should surface them.

Marissa — would you own voucher wording and the front-facing promo terms? If yes I can route approval to finance today.

Ben
--
Ben Carter
Director, Partner Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-promo-approval-form.pdf; redwood-promo-terms-v1.pdf

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: Sandeep Kumar <sandeep.kumar@edgescale.com>, jordan.blake@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: marketplace-team@cloudbazaar.com
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-funding request for EdgeScale x Redwood pilot (marketplace listing) — approved voucher

Hi Sandeep — good news, we've approved a co-funded voucher for the EdgeScale pilot. Details below and next steps.

What we approved:
- Redwood credit: $25,000 (EdgeScale to provide $25,000)
- Voucher validity: activates on first redemption and expires 60 days after activation
- Guardrails: initial daily cap 40k tokens/day; telemetry events required (request_id, model_id, latency p95) for the first 30 days

How voucher will be issued:
- Marketplace team at CloudBazaar will create a single voucher code linked to the EdgeScale listing. You will receive a CloudBazaar voucher issuance link where you can redeem or distribute to the pilot account.
- Marketplace link/issuance: https://cloudbazaar.com/partner/vouchers/issue?request=9741

Required items before issuance:
- Signed promo approval form (attached) — Ben has routed this to finance and cost center PRM-PROMO-9741.
- Confirmation of the pilot AWS account ID or CloudBazaar vendor account handle to pin the voucher.

Attachments and links:
- redwood-promo-terms-v1.pdf (promo terms and telemetry requirements)
- Doc to sign: https://redwood.signnow.com/s/PRM-9741-promo-approval

Next steps for EdgeScale:
1) Reply with the pilot account (or a CloudBazaar handle) and confirm EdgeScale will sign the promo approval doc.
2) We'll trigger voucher creation once finance acknowledges cost code is provisioned.
3) Kickoff call to align telemetry and case-study milestones (I'll propose Wed next week).

If you need a slightly larger voucher we can review, but we'd need SR approval for >$25k Redwood exposure.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Partner Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0177

Attachments: redwood-promo-terms-v1.pdf (PDF, 22KB)
